Eau Galle Grain Company
                                     N435 State Road 25

Corn Discount Schedule

Test Weight: $.02/bu each lb 54-52#
             $.03/bu each ½ lb 50-52#
             $.05/bu each ½ lb 48-50#
             $.10/bu each ½ lb under 48#

BCFM:          $.03/bu each 1% 3.1-4%
               $.07/bu each 1% 4.1-5%
               $.08/bu each 1% 5.1-6%
               $.10/bu each 1% 6.1-10%
               Shipments over 10% subject to rejection

Heat Damage: $.02/bu each .1% from .2%-3%

Damage:        $.02/bu each 1% over 5-7%
               $.03/bu each 1% over 7-10%

Musty:        $.10/bu
Sour:         $.12/bu
COFO:         $.20/bu
Infested:     $.20/bu
Foreign Substance: $.25/bu

Open Storage: $.05/bu/month
Price Later Contract Corn: $.04/bu/month

Out Charge:     $.15/bu on grain not hauled by Mellenthin Grain Services LLC

A rollover charge of $.25/bushel will be assessed to all corn not priced by September 1st each
year.
                Eau Galle Grain Company
                                     N435 State Road 25
                                     Eau Galle, WI 54737

Soybean Discount Schedule

Test Weight:          $.02/bu each lb 54-50#
                      $.03/bu each lb 49.9-48#
                      $.04/bu each lb under 48#

Bean Shrinkage:       1.5% each ½% 13%-14.99%
                      2.0% each ½% 15%-16.99%
                      2.5% each ½% 17%-17.99%
                      Please call when delivering soybeans over 18%

Damage:               $.05/bu each point over 2%

Foreign Material:     All FM over 1% will be taken off of gross weight

Splits:        $.02/bu per % over 20%

Musty:        $.10/bu
Sour:         $.15/bu
COFO:         $.20/bu
Infested:     $.20/bu
Foreign Substance: $.25/bu

Open Storage: $.06/bu/month
Price Later Contract Soybeans: $.05/bu/month

Out Charge:    $.15/bu on grain not hauled by Mellenthin Grain Services LLC

A rollover charge of $.25/bushel will be assessed to all soybeans not priced by September 1st
each year.
